title: A large-scale crowd-sourced analysis of abuse against women journalists and politicians on Twitter
findings: Ethnic or religious slurs were identified as a specific category of abuse directed at women journalists and politicians on Twitter, accounting for 5% of the abusive content identified in the dataset.
